description: Fresh Roma tomatoes for processing that are preserved through a commercial process using chemical additives, intended for use in salsa products.
hts_note: Roma tomatoes preserved commercially for processing fall under tomatoes prepared or preserved otherwise than by vinegar or acetic acid, whole or in pieces.

description: Specially processed, beveled aluminum foil conductor designed for use in transformer coil windings.
hts_note: Classified as aluminum foil, not backed, further worked (beveled) and exceeding 0.15 mm but not exceeding 0.2 mm in thickness, excluded from Chapter 85 by Section XVI Note 1(f).

description: Hardwood plywood assembled from two-ply panels.
hts_note: Classified as hardwood plywood consisting solely of sheets of wood with each ply not exceeding 6 mm in thickness under heading 4412.

description: Graphite rods possessing the physical characteristics of unfinished small diameter graphite electrodes, suitable for machining into graphite pin joining systems.
hts_note: Graphite rods with the physical characteristics of unfinished furnace electrodes or pins are classified as furnace electrodes of graphite under GRI 2(a).

description: Aluminum extrusions made from an Aluminum Association 6-series alloy, imported as components of a bogie wheel kit.
hts_note: Classified as other aluminum alloy profiles (6-series) not constituting finished vehicle parts.

description: Three models of light-truck tires designed and marketed exclusively for use as temporary-use spare tires for light trucks.
hts_note: New pneumatic radial tires of rubber of a kind used on light trucks are classified under subheading 4011.20.1015.

description: Western red cedar shingles.
hts_note: Classified under heading 4418 as builders' joinery and carpentry of wood, specifically wood shingles of Western red cedar.

description: Polyvinyl chloride (PVC) door gaskets that feature an internal pocket encasing a raw flexible magnetic band not permanently affixed by adhesive, heat processing, or pressure.
hts_note: PVC door gaskets incorporating a flexible magnetic strip function primarily as seals classifiable as other articles of plastics.

description: Two beverage stations or beverage centers designed for non-permanent installation.
hts_note: Classified as other wooden furniture designed for freestanding or non-permanent installation rather than built-in joinery.

description: Stainless steel trash can bodies, imported either by themselves or alongside other components, manufactured from stainless steel sheet and strip.
hts_note: Stainless steel trash can bodies are classified as parts of household articles of stainless steel.

description: Lengthwise sawn scarf-jointed wood reveal strips and lengthwise sawn scarf-jointed wood squares.
hts_note: Wood sawn lengthwise, end-jointed (scarf-jointed), and of a thickness exceeding 6 mm is classified under heading 4407.

description: Solar cells and modules manufactured using crystalline silicon wafers sourced globally, including from China, Korea, Malaysia, and Vietnam.
hts_note: Classified as crystalline silicon photovoltaic cells assembled into modules or panels under heading 8541.

description: RAPiD Safe Ready Vaults and SnapSafe Titan metal gun vaults, which are metal security vaults designed for the secure storage of firearms and valuables.
hts_note: Base metal security vaults and gun safes are classified as armored or reinforced safes and strong-boxes under heading 8303.

description: Passenger vehicle steel wheels, models X-45282, X-45329, X-45333, X-45334, X-45337, X-45399, X-45401, X-45460, X-45463, X-45477, and X-45304, configured for passenger vehicles with specific bolt patterns, offsets, pilot diameters, and load ratings unsuitable for trailers or towable equipment.
hts_note: Classified as road wheels of steel for passenger motor vehicles under heading 8708.

description: Flat jambs as well as super and stapled jambs manufactured from wood and containing no more than 50 percent composite material.
hts_note: Wooden door jambs function as and form part of door frames, classified under builders' joinery as wooden door frames.

description: Wheel caps designed and utilized solely for marine trailers, utility trailers, and recreational vehicles, and not for further assembly with a finished or unfinished chassis.
hts_note: Classified as other parts of trailers and semi-trailers under heading 8716.

description: The Chloe Styling Station, a freestanding wooden salon cabinet not designed for permanent installation, and the Sanden Shampoo Cabinet (AYC Styling Station), a salon cabinet designed for permanent installation via plumbing attachment.
hts_note: Classified as other wooden furniture, as these salon cabinets are articles of furniture not specifically provided for elsewhere in heading 9403.

description: Plastic shelf dividers comprised of a component plastic blade attached to a magnet component.
hts_note: The plastic shelf divider with a magnetic base is classified as an article of plastics, which imparts the essential character of the item.

description: Passenger vehicle wheels, model numbers X-76801 and 28860W, with a diameter of 16 inches and hub bore sizes, offsets, and load ratings designed for passenger vehicles rather than trailers or towable equipment.
hts_note: Classified as road wheels of steel designed for passenger vehicles of heading 8703.

description: Polyester fabrics primed or coated with ethylene-vinyl acetate (EVACPET) imported in rolls, used for converting, printing, varnishing, and framing as artwork prints and custom photos.
hts_note: Woven polyester fabric coated or laminated with ethylene-vinyl acetate (a plastic other than PVC or polyurethane) is classified as a coated textile fabric of man-made fibers under heading 5903.

description: Three models of aluminum pair ramps designed for loading and vehicle support.
hts_note: Portable aluminum loading ramps are classified as other articles of aluminum, not elsewhere specified or included.

description: Off-grid 100-watt solar panels constructed with regular monocrystalline solar cells (model numbers RNG-KIT-STCS100D-NC, RNG-KIT-STCS100D[1]VOY20, RNG-100D-SS, and RNG-100DB-H) and off-grid 50-watt solar panels (model numbers RNG-50D-SS and RKIT50DST).
hts_note: Classified as crystalline silicon photovoltaic cells assembled into modules or made up into panels.

description: A cassette cart designed without a projecting edge or toeplate capable of sliding under a load for lifting or moving.
hts_note: Classified as other non-mechanically propelled vehicles and handcarts, falling outside hand trucks with projecting toeplates.

description: Modified vertical shaft internal combustion engines featuring a vertical power take-off shaft, such as model modified R210-S, with an engine displacement between 99cc and up to 225cc.
hts_note: Classified as a spark-ignition reciprocating internal combustion engine of the vertical shaft type producing less than 4,476 W.

description: Wire mesh in 8 x 131 foot rolls, with dimensions and designations of 6X6 W1.4/W1.4 or D.14/D1.4 (10 gauge).
hts_note: Welded wire mesh of steel with wire diameter of 3 mm or more (10 gauge / W1.4 is approx. 3.4 mm) and mesh area of 100 cm2 or more (6x6 inches is approx. 232 cm2).

description: Composite marble tile consisting of a marble top layer bonded to a porcelain tile base layer.
hts_note: Pursuant to GRI 3(b), the marble facing imparts the essential character to the composite tile, classifying it as worked marble under heading 6802.

description: PowerSolar 3-Port 100W Foldable Outdoor Solar Panel (Model A2431), designed for portable off-grid power generation.
hts_note: Classified as photovoltaic cells assembled in modules or made up into panels for solar power generation.

description: Certain models of trailer wheels assembled from steel rims and discs manufactured from rectangular steel plates, measuring 12 to 16.5 inches in diameter.
hts_note: Classified as parts of trailers, specifically steel wheels with a rim diameter of 12 inches to 16.5 inches.

description: Eight fitting components of the LargeBore Frac System, manufactured for hydraulic fracturing applications to non-standard specifications.
hts_note: Custom-manufactured high-pressure pipe fittings of alloy steel for hydraulic fracturing systems are classified under heading 7307 as other pipe fittings of alloy steel.

description: The product is an isotopically labeled form of ammonium sulfate enriched with the nitrogen-15 isotope (15N ammonium sulfate).
hts_note: Classified under heading 2845 as a compound of an isotope (nitrogen-15) other than those of heading 2844.

description: Eight models of rear loaded knuckles designed for automotive suspension assemblies.
hts_note: Rear suspension knuckles are classified as parts of motor vehicle suspension systems under heading 8708.

description: Sinks, basins, shower trays, and integrated vanity tops made of engineered quartz stone surface material.
hts_note: Engineered quartz is an agglomerated artificial stone bound with resin, classifying these sanitary fixtures as other articles of artificial stone.

description: Steel trailer wheels and dual wheel trailer wheels assembled from steel rims and discs, utilizing various combinations of processed steel plates, disc blanks, or pre-formed components.
hts_note: Classified as parts of trailers and semi-trailers, specifically steel trailer wheels.

description: A mobile utility fan that lacks a toeplate or horizontal projecting edge for sliding under, lifting, or moving a load.
hts_note: Mobile utility fans lacking hand truck features such as a toeplate are classified as other fans under heading 8414.

description: Large and small garlic chunks that have been reduced in size beyond peeling and are no longer whole or separated into constituent cloves.
hts_note: Fresh garlic that has been cut or chopped into chunks, rather than presented as whole bulbs or intact cloves, is classified as other fresh garlic under heading 0703.

description: Truck wheels assembled from wheel discs and rims manufactured from steel sheet plates.
hts_note: Classified under road wheels of steel designed for trucks (motor vehicles of heading 8704).

description: Hex nut sleeve anchors that include a headed bolt.
hts_note: Hex nut sleeve anchors containing a bolt and nut assembly are classified as steel bolts with their nuts or washers under heading 7318.

description: Carbon steel wedge anchors that include a headed bolt.
hts_note: Carbon steel wedge anchors composed of a headed or threaded bolt with an expansion mechanism and nut/washer are classified as steel bolts under subheading 7318.15.20.

description: Hex nut sleeve anchors that include a headed bolt.
hts_note: Hex nut sleeve anchors containing a bolt and nut assembly are classified as steel bolts with their nuts or washers under heading 7318.

description: Carbon steel wedge anchors that include a headed bolt.
hts_note: Carbon steel wedge anchors composed of a headed or threaded bolt with an expansion mechanism and nut/washer are classified as steel bolts under subheading 7318.15.20.

description: Various wooden bedroom furniture pieces and mirrors across the Glimmering Heights, Melrose Plaza, Hollywood Swank, and Hollywood Loft collections, including upholstered accent cabinets and nightstands, storage consoles and dressers, vertical chests of drawers, upholstered swivel chiffoniers and lingerie chests, upholstered vanities and desks, and upholstered mirrors.
hts_note: Classified as wooden furniture of a kind used in the bedroom, specifically chests of drawers, dressing tables, and commodes.

description: Wooden floor cabinets designed for bathroom storage, including the Avery Floor Cabinet with Two Doors (model ELG-542), Free Standing Versailles Double Floor Cabinet in white (model ELG-550) and espresso (model ELG-571), Freestanding Rain Glass Floor Cabinet with two doors in white (model ELG-580), and Freestanding St. James Linen Tower with two doors and two drawers in white (models 592C1 top and 592C2 bottom).
hts_note: Classified as other wooden furniture of a kind used in the home, excluding kitchen or bedroom specific furnishings.

description: Crushed glass surface products wherein the crushed glass content exceeds that of any other single material by actual weight, with visible surface glass pieces measuring over one centimeter at their widest cross-section and spaced no more than three inches apart.
hts_note: Classified as prefabricated or building panels of artificial stone consisting of agglomerated crushed glass bound with cement or resin.
